Message:
net: Move ipv4 set_lwt_redirect helper to lwtunnel

IPv4 uses set_lwt_redirect to set the lwtunnel redirect functions as
needed. Move it to lwtunnel.h as lwtunnel_set_redirect and change
IPv6 to also use it.
